text: Mobile app development is an exciting field with many important choices. One key decision is whether to build a native app for one platform or a cross-platform app that works on both iOS and Android. Native apps often offer better performance, while cross-platform solutions save time and money. Another crucial factor is responsive design, which ensures the app looks good on different screen sizes. When your app is ready, you must publish it on app stores like Google Play or the Apple App Store. Remember that performance matters a lot: users expect fast, smooth apps, so always test carefully before releasing your product.
